# Official Bhutan RCDC evidence

Captured on 2026-11-17.

- `rcdc_w43_w44_2026.pdf`: unmodified official [2026 week 43–44 PDF](https://www.rcdc.gov.bt/web/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/Wk-4344.pdf), linked by [post 8511](https://www.rcdc.gov.bt/web/?p=8511).
- `publication_8511_content.html`: only the post-content element from post 8511, wrapped in HTML for a focused link-discovery fixture.
- `publications_excerpt.html`: official homepage article elements for posts 8511, 8508, 8433, 8453, and 1161. This is an excerpt, not a complete archive.
- `latest_events_excerpt.html`: the separate official homepage latest-event table; its counts are event snapshots, not incident disease observations.

Live-original hashes and verified laboratory observations are recorded in `docs/data-sources/evidence/bt-rcdc-20261117.json`. These snapshots serve offline integration tests and do not assert that disease surveillance is complete.
